sceneActor-name.label: Name
sceneActor-name.tip: Actor Name (note: this is a label for user reference only)

sceneActor-type.label: Type
sceneActor-type.tip: Choose whether to create a temporary or permanent actor

local.name: Local Actor
local.tip: Temporary actor automatically destroyed when scene unloads

global.name: Global Actor
global.tip: Permanent actor; if exists, it is transported to current scene

sceneActor-angle-box.label: Angle
sceneActor-angle-box.tip:
Actor's initial angle; affects animation orientation
Shortcut keys (Ctrl+↑/↓/←/→) set angle quickly for selected Actor

sceneActor-scale-box.label: Scale
sceneActor-scale-box.tip: Actor scaling; affects size of Actor animations and Animation Components

sceneActor-conditions.label: Conditions
sceneActor-conditions.tip: Set conditions for Actor creation; if unmet, Actor isn't created

sceneActor-events.label: Events
sceneActor-events.tip:
$Actor Events
These events do not run if Actor isn't active (is 'dead') or if deleted
Events here override those in the Actor file
$Event Types
Create: Triggered at Actor initialization (once)
Autorun: Triggered when Actor appears (including after reading save data)
Collision: Triggered when Actor collides with another Actor
Hit Trigger: Triggered when Actor collides with a Trigger
Custom: triggered via 'Call Event'

sceneActor-scripts.label: Scripts
sceneActor-scripts.tip: Add Script files to extend Actor functions
